content.value: The Passive Tree is your permanent combat build. Its connected routes determine which bonuses you can reach from your chosen class.

Choose a class to unlock its configured start node.
Click a connected available node to draft it.
Continue drafting through nodes connected to the start or another drafted/unlocked node.
Choose [[stat/cranks-dungeons:strength|Strength]], [[stat/cranks-dungeons:dexterity|Dexterity]], or [[stat/cranks-dungeons:intelligence|Intelligence]] when a drafted attribute-choice node requests it.
Review the point total and press Apply Changes. Apply commits the route and spends its points.
Drafting is only a preview. Click a drafted node again to remove it before applying. Applied points and nodes are persistent.

Shapes and icons communicate importance and category, but the exact modifier list in a node tooltip is what it actually grants. Attribute-choice nodes grant their configured amount to the selected primary attribute.

Press P for direct access or enter through the Compendium.
Drag to pan and use the wheel to zoom.
Hover a node to read all modifiers and requirements.
Available, drafted, unlocked, and unreachable nodes use distinct visual states.
Do not rely on a screenshot from another server. Passive Tree content is configurable and is synchronized from the server you joined.

Node bonus descriptions are generated from the stats the node actually grants, including their values and units. Choice nodes list alternatives: choose one bonus, rather than gaining every listed option. Hold Show Details (Shift by default) to enter the tooltip and click a bonus for its explanation in the Compendium.
